mapper.select: SELECT id AS userId, login_id AS username, name, email, phone, created_at AS createdAt, password, role FROM user WHERE id = #{userId}

SELECT r.id AS reservationId, s.name AS stationName, r.reservation_type AS reservationType, r.status, rt.start_time AS startTime, rt.end_time AS endTime, rtg.target_kwh AS targetAmount, c.connector_type AS connectorType, em.model_name AS carType FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN reservation_time rt ON r.id = rt.reservation_id LEFT JOIN reservation_target rtg ON r.id = rtg.reservation_id LEFT JOIN user_vehicle uv ON r.user_vehicle_id = uv.id LEFT JOIN ev_model em ON uv.model_id = em.id JOIN charger c ON r.charger_id = c.id JOIN station s ON c.station_id = s.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} /* 🌟 핵심: 예약 확정 상태이거나 현재 충전 중인 건만 예정 예약에 노출 */ AND r.status IN ('RESERVED', 'CHARGING')
AND rt.end_time >= NOW()
ORDER BY rt.start_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_target (reservation_id, target_kwh, max_minutes) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{targetAmount}, #{maxMinutes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE target_kwh = #{targetAmount}, max_minutes = #{maxMinutes}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS reservationId, r.charger_id AS chargerId, c.station_id AS stationId, c.power_kw AS powerKw, c.connector_type AS connectorType, r.reservation_type AS reservationType, r.status, rt.start_time AS startTime, rt.end_time AS endTime, rtg.target_kwh AS targetAmount, s.name AS stationName, em.model_name AS carType, em.connector_type AS carConnectorType, em.battery_capacity AS batteryCapacity FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN reservation_time rt ON r.id = rt.reservation_id LEFT JOIN reservation_target rtg ON r.id = rtg.reservation_id LEFT JOIN user_vehicle uv ON r.user_vehicle_id = uv.id LEFT JOIN ev_model em ON uv.model_id = em.id JOIN charger c ON r.charger_id = c.id JOIN station s ON c.station_id = s.id WHERE r.id = #{reservationId}
